description.message: See any price on a page in your own currency.

notice_onboardedReset.message: Onboarding flag was corrupted — reset to not passed.

notice_langReset.message: Language "{value}" is unknown — reset to English.

notice_themeReset.message: Theme "{value}" is unknown — reset to dark.

notice_overlayThemeReset.message: Overlay theme "{value}" is unknown — reset to auto.

notice_currencyReset.message: Currency {code} is no longer in the list — target reset to USD.

popup_onboardingPending.message: Setup isn't finished yet — amounts on pages will appear after it.

input_range.message: This is a range, not an amount.

error_network_detail.message: The {from} → {to} rate wasn't received: the browser couldn't reach the rate server.

error_timeout_detail.message: 8 seconds with no answer; the {from} → {to} rate wasn't received.

error_tooMany_detail.message: The server limited the request rate ({status}) for {from} → {to}.

error_rateLimit_detail.message: We asked for {from} → {to} too often; the extension holds back to spare the server.

error_server_detail.message: The server answered {status} — the problem is on its side, not in your settings.

error_noRate_detail.message: The server answered {status} for {from} → {to}; retrying won't help.

error_unparseable_detail.message: The answer for {from} → {to} has no rate field ({status}). This is our bug.

onboarding_step1Lead.message: Language, look and the currency your amounts on pages are shown in. All three can be changed later in settings.

onboarding_step2Title.message: Select the amount — not the sentence

onboarding_step2Lead.message: Select just the price — see the amount in your currency.

onboarding_gapHint.message: Drag the slider to change the spacing.
